entries.why: pointer to the pattern's accessor object that the pad LED code reads (6 literal pool words in the LED manager code 0xC0087DF4 to 0xC0089D78): fwmap's vote over the pool words of both images, unanimous

pointer to the pattern that the 26 Edit info formatters read (literal pool words 0xC00801FC to 0xC0080EA8): fwmap's vote over the pool words of both images, unanimous; 0x1C below the accessor pointer in both builds
the info line builder's read of the label flag (ldrb r3, [r0, #0x5c]), +4 of the builder 0xC0086848 / 0xC00768F0: the 16 words around it equal in both images (fwmap same code)
the instruction after that read, where the hook goes on
the firmware's own pad refresh after a pattern load (LED manager, mode 4 draws the steps): the 16 words around it equal in both images (fwmap same code)
the part mute getter (ldr r3, [r0, #4]; mla with 0x330; ldrb [r1, #0x805]), the pad LEDs' mute loop 0xC0087D9C / 0xC0077EF0 calls it: the 16 words around it equal in both images (fwmap same code)
the instruction after the getter's first, where the hook goes on
the part mute setter (accessor, part, mute, notify): strb of the mute at +0x805 of the part, the main screen's PART MUTE pad calls it: the 16 words around it equal in both images (fwmap same code)

the main screen's PART MUTE pad calls the mute setter with the inverted mute it read through the getter (bl getter; rsbs r2, r0, #1; movlo r2, #0; mov r0, r5; bl setter), read in both images; measured: the press reaches it (docs/messungen/2026-10-30-vorschau-part-reinholen.md)

Copy Part (Part Util 1/4): the object's +0x40 source pattern and +0x41 source part, PSEL and the chosen number, the source from the pattern in RAM or the bank, memcpy of 0x330 bytes into the target part, the setters, the motion copy; the synth takes the target part in r1 (no stereo pairs). Read in both images; measured: the memcpy into the part is called from 0xC0066904 / 0xC005C548 when MENU and the pads run Copy Part (docs/messungen/2026-10-30-vorschau-part-reinholen.md)
